blocks.content: Specialized Academic Council D 08.231.01 with the right to consider and conduct the defense of dissertations for the degree of Doctor of Technical Sciences in the specialties:
05.16.01 – Materials Science and Heat Treatment of Metals;
05.16.02 – Metallurgy of Ferrous, Non-Ferrous Metals and Special Alloys.
Chairman of the Council: Chernyatevych Anatolii Hryhorovych, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Professor, Chief Researcher.
Deputy Chairman: Merkulov Oleksii Yevhenovych, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher, Deputy Director of the Institute.
Academic Secretary: Kononenko Hanna Andriivna, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher.
Term of office of the Specialized Academic Council D 08.231.01 is from 26.06.2024 to 26.06.2027.

On July 10, 2026, at 10:00, a meeting of the specialized academic council D 08.231.01 will host the defense of the dissertation prepared by Dmytro Oleksandrovych Stepanenko, Head of the Department of Physicochemical Problems of Metallurgical Processes at the Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine, on the topic "Development of Scientific Foundations for Determining the Structural State of Slag Melts for Selecting a Rational Chemical Composition in Pig Iron and Steel Production" in the specialty 05.16.02 – Metallurgy of Ferrous and Non-Ferrous Metals and Special Alloys (Technical Sciences) for the degree of Doctor of Technical Sciences. Scientific Consultant – Daria Mykolaivna Tohobytska, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Professor, Leading Researcher of the Department of Physicochemical Problems of Metallurgical Processes at the Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine, Dnipro.

data.title: Conclusion on scientific novelty, theoretical and practical significance of the doctoral dissertation results

blocks.content: On July 10, 2026, at 13:00, a meeting of the specialized academic council D 08.231.01 will host the defense of the dissertation prepared by Valerii Ivanovych Vyshnyakov, Researcher of the Pig Iron Metallurgy Department at the Z.I. Nekrasov Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine, on the topic "Improvement of Methods for Determining the Composition of Burden Material Mixtures in Different Zones of a Blast Furnace and Evaluation of the Properties of Their Primary Melts" in the specialty 05.16.02 – Metallurgy of Ferrous and Non-Ferrous Metals and Special Alloys (Technical Sciences) for the degree of Candidate of Technical Sciences. Scientific Supervisor – Iryna Hennadiivna Muravyova, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Professor, Leading Researcher of the Pig Iron Metallurgy Department at the Institute of Ferrous Metallurgy of the NAS of Ukraine, Dnipro.
